$comment: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/audit-deps.mjs. Each one needs a reason (why it can't be exploited here, or why the fix is a planned major upgrade) and an expiry date; CI fails again when it expires. See docs/security-review.md (A06).

advisories.reason: Memory exhaustion when validating oversized constrained collections. Request bodies are capped at MAX_JSON_BODY_KB (1 MB) before Zod sees them, and every array in a request schema has a max() (checked: the arrays without one are response and OpenAPI shapes only). The fix is Zod 4 (a breaking upgrade of every schema plus zod-to-openapi 8): planned as its own change.

Stack exhaustion when merging recursive object graphs. Only the Prisma CLI merges its own config file at migrate / generate time; no request data reaches it. The fix is Prisma 7 (driver adapters, new config): planned as its own change.
Source-map file read during CSS processing. PostCSS runs only at build time on StockBook's own stylesheets; no user CSS is ever processed. The fix is Next.js 16: planned as its own change.
Same as GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q: build-time only, own stylesheets only.
